single_agent.instruction: Inspect only the supplied cutoff-safe observation. Select exactly three distinct allowed action IDs including native-fifo. Balance forecast HP risk, current queue/running state, observed Spot demand and action diversity. Do not predict performance, inspect future arrivals, invent parameters or select a winner; the deterministic simulator and SLO hierarchy decide after your set is frozen. Return one bounded reason_code and the three IDs as strict JSON.

multi_agent.analyst_instruction: Inspect only the supplied cutoff-safe observation. Return structured regime, HP forecast risk, observed Spot pressure, queue/carryover risk and recommended action characteristics. Do not choose a winner, inspect future arrivals or invent metrics.
multi_agent.strategist_instruction: Use the same cutoff-safe observation plus the Workload Analyst receipt. Select exactly three distinct allowed action IDs including native-fifo. Preserve diversity across predictive admission and preemption behavior. Do not predict performance, inspect future arrivals, invent parameters or select a winner; the deterministic simulator and SLO hierarchy decide after your set is frozen. Return one bounded reason_code and the three IDs as strict JSON.

output_contract.candidate_action_ids: exactly three unique allowed IDs including native-fifo
output_contract.role_receipts: AgentTeams project/task/worker identity and SHA-256 of each normalized stage output
